title: Moat
summary: MOAT, noun In fortification, a ditch or deep trench round the rampart of a castle or other fortified place. It is sometimes filled with water. MOAT, verb transitive To surround with a ditch for defens

inlines.v: MOAT, noun In fortification, a ditch or deep trench round the rampart of a castle or other fortified place. It is sometimes filled with water. MOAT, verb transitive To surround with a ditch for defense; as a moated castle.
